title: Pan-Seared Fennel with Midnight Crisp
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring the sweetness of fennel and the crunch of midnight and crunch.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced fennel and cook for 5 minutes, or until it starts to soften.
Add the chopped midnight and crunch and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
